purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Runyenjes Form 34B final TOTAL row, read directly from the official IEBC portal PDF.

sample.review_context_note: 3-page form; page 2 of 3 carries the final TOTAL row but is rendered upside down (rotated 180 degrees) in this particular scan. The page was rotated 180 degrees before review so the TOTAL row could be read upright; column order and constituency identity (RUNYENJES / code 064) were confirmed from the CON 064 marker in the page header, also upside down in the source scan but legible after rotation. No third-party crop pipeline or CI artifact was used. The PDF has no embedded text layer (confirmed by direct extraction attempt), so all values were read visually from the rendered, rotated page image, cross-checked against a tight high-DPI crop isolating just the TOTAL row band.

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session (via the governed form_id = constituency_code + 277628 locator, after resetting the portal session from its default by-election context to the 2022 general election via index.php?r=common/set-election&id=5), its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered, rotated page image, then independently cross-confirmed with a separately rendered high-DPI crop of the same row (scripts/p23/crop_page.py, page rendered then rotated 180 degrees). No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.

note: This evidence establishes a source-verified row under the extraction contract. Canonical materialization is authorized only by the separate governed promotion tranche in data/p23/form34b-turnout-promotion-contract.json.
